scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @collab/server && npm run build -w @collab/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
